neighbours.label: 'to' or the object marking the recipient after a verb of giving or handing over (given to, present him with)
fire: The keys to the house were handed to the new owner on Friday.
Each winner was given a medal and a small cash prize.
The old books were donated to the village library last year.
She sent a long letter to her brother in Canada.
The money was transferred to the supplier's account this morning.
Please pass the salt to your grandmother at the end of the table.
The award was presented to the volunteers who cleaned the beach.
Grandpa gave his watch to me before he moved away.
quiet: The new owner wants to move into the house on Friday.
Each winner wanted to celebrate with a small party.
The old books were carried to the attic last year.
She went to Canada to visit her brother.
The supplier tried to open a new account this morning.
Please remember to sit next to your grandmother at the table.
The volunteers walked to the beach to clean it.
Grandpa used to wear his watch every day before he moved away.

notes: Card: ' to' x13 after given/deposited/present; the + pole's output promotes added, assigned, send, handed, so the axis is transfer to a recipient. Near misses use 'to' as an infinitive or a direction.
